Subject: Week ahead
Date: Monday 9 November 2026
From: Dom Selvon <dom@valliance.ai>
To: Priya Nandra <priya.nandra@harlowbrook.example.test>

Priya,

Setting out the week so nothing slips.

I will send the updated migration plan on Tuesday. I will also send the test strategy by Friday, once our test lead has reviewed it.

On your side, you said you would confirm the go live date with the operations team by Wednesday.

Best,
Dom
